transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Nisha. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hello Nisha, main Karan Wilson hoon. Mera network coverage area mein bahut kharab hai, I am very frustrated with this service!
Agent: I am truly sorry to hear that you are facing these network issues, Mr. Wilson. I understand how frustrating it is when your connection is unstable.
Customer: Haan, it's just not working. Isliye main apna connection cancel karna chahta hoon. I will switch to another provider because this is unacceptable.
Agent: We would hate to lose you as a customer. May I ask if there is any specific area where the signal is worst?
Customer: Mere ghar ke andar signal nahi aata. My phone number is 95462 38028, please just process the cancellation.
Agent: I can certainly help you with that. Just so you know, there is no early-termination fee for your current plan, and your final bill will arrive via email within the next seven business days.
Customer: Okay, that's fine. Bas jaldi se cancel kar do please.
Agent: I have now processed your cancellation request in our system, and you will receive a confirmation SMS shortly.
Customer: Thank you, Nisha. Aapne bahut help ki, I am satisfied now.
Agent: You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Your account is now set for closure, and you will receive the final bill soon. Goodbye!
